description: Post-quantum-ready cryptography library for Android and JVM. Wire-compatible with the SaQura .NET (NuGet) and Swift (SPM) packages — data encrypted in any of the three SDKs decrypts identically in the others. Surfaces: AES-256-GCM, RSA-4096 (OAEP encrypt + PSS sign), PBKDF2-SHA512 password hashing, FrodoKEM + Classic-McEliece post-quantum KEM, offline license activation.
